intro.summary: A nine-day prayer to St Corona, a Christian martyr, asking her intercession for protection and healing during pandemics and widespread illness.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Corona Novena Against Pandemics below.
blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

‘Faithful Saint Corona, who willingly received the crown of martyrdom for the Catholic Faith, I ask for thy intercession against disease and pandemics. Pray for me and my family, for my loved ones, and for every person who is in harm’’s way of sickness. Through thy intercession, obtain the protection of our physical health from our Lord’’s goodness, if it be God’’s will, and if not, obtain for us the help to remain in sanctifying grace and so to be ready always to meet our Lord face-to-face.
Saint Corona, patron against plagues, pray for us!
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

blocks.title: Days 1-9

fragments.text:
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses,
as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
fragments.title: Our Father

fragments.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
fragments.title: Hail Mary

fragments.text:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
fragments.title: Glory Be
